title: Equality of an embedded configuration
statement: Let $\Gamma,S$ be types, let $m,k$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be an input word over $\Gamma$. Let $\iota$ be an injection from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let $a,d$ be configurations with $m$ and $k$ work tapes, respectively. Choose contents and head positions for the $k$ tapes, and a prefix word. If $a$ and $d$ have the same state and input-head position; each tape of $a$ agrees with the corresponding embedded tape of $d$, including its head position; every tape of $d$ outside the image of $\iota$ agrees with the chosen contents and head positions; and the prefix followed by the output of $a$ equals the output of $d$, then embedding $a$ into the $k$-tape configuration with those outside tapes and prefix produces exactly $d$.
